Dr Kwan has considered testing whether the animals can help each other to avoid pain.
Explain why this might be an unethical procedure.

Dr Kwan should use as few animals as possible, for ethical reasons.
State why it would also be important that Dr Kwan uses a big enough sample.

Dr Kwan has developed behavioural categories for observing the animals. However, he thinks
that another researcher should conduct the observations rather than him.
Explain why this is a good idea.
